Market today: The 10-year Treasury yield hitting 5% again is the main driver, spooking the market and hitting growth/tech names hard. Your book is almost entirely in this sector, so this is the primary headwind.

Your holdings: SMCI (-37.36%), MU (-61.41%), SOXL (-76.04%), SPAL (-44.49%), and PLTU (-27.61%) are all leveraged ETFs deep in the red and flagged for attention. QQQ (-6.32%), SMH (-24.8%), SNOW (-13.51%), and METU (-13.79%) are also showing losses and need watching.

Watch: Keep an eye on the 10-year Treasury yield. If it continues to climb, it will put more pressure on your concentrated tech holdings.

Bottom line: Your leveraged ETFs are bleeding, and the market's focus on rising rates is a direct threat to your concentrated tech book.
plays: Consider trimming leveraged ETFs like SOXL, MU, SPAL, PLTU if they show further weakness.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
